name: 49401 · Allendale, MI
findings: ZIP 49401 (Allendale) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49401 (Allendale) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
48% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 49401 (Allendale) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
